text: Harborview's leadership agreed on who needs what. Now that gets turned into one written access policy -- specific enough that a system, not a person's good judgment, can actually enforce it.

Billing and Finance get clinic-level aggregates only. Clinical Quality gets patient-level trend data across every clinic, with name and SSN always returning NULL. Only the Compliance audit role sees real, unmasked identifiers -- and every one of their queries has to trace back to one person.
Each clause gets a way to prove it's true: query the Clinical Quality role against any clinic, and SSN must be NULL, with zero exceptions.
One request almost snuck in during review -- Finance occasionally wanting one clinic's detail rows. It got logged as its own request instead of quietly widening the policy.
The policy is signed off. Next: deciding exactly what ships in version one, and what waits.
